stagingLines: [d71] You catch fragments by the fire — Devon telling Zoe about herself. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
[d71] ◈ SYSTEM: "You are not the head of this. That is the point. A realm of 4 fires — and Emberhold wants Haven's oath. The audience LOVES a binding."

[d71] 📯 Emberhold's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
[d71] 📓 Codex: National beat staged: belong (4 villages).
[d71] A sharp-eyed peddler waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
[d71] 📺 TONIGHT: The Moot. Televised trials and debates. The village holds court on camera; the galaxy is the jury.
[d71] 📺 The cameras want YOU — won 10 contests.
[d71] 📺 That's not an honor. It's just what the aliens like to see. You're going on television.
[d71] 📺 ● LIVE — The Moot. YOU is on television.
[d71] 📺 You are WATCHING. This is a scene playing out — not your life. Nobody dies on television. That is the rule. Probably.
[d71] 📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: 🎬 CUT TO: And we are LIVE across seventeen systems! Tonight: The Moot. Try to contain yourselves.

[d71] 📺 The Moot — the village holds a trial, on camera.

The charge is read aloud. It might even be yours. The jury is seventeen systems of beings who have never been accused of anything. Your village fills the gallery. Everyone is performing, a little.
[d71] ⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.
[d71] Village meal: +190 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
[d71] 🩹 Fatima makes rounds — Devon gets bound up properly. (51 → 66 HP)
followLines: [d72] Village meal: +200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
[d72] 🩹 Fatima makes rounds — Ivy gets bound up properly. (57 → 72 HP)
[d72] Konrad and Ivy are comparing scars like trading cards.
[d72] 🔍 Devon crouches over a low woodland plant with a whorl of compound leaves and a small cluster of red berries — rare, and protected, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
[d72] Devon is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 43/100)
[d72] Ivy and Konrad lingered over the fire together.
[d72] Ivy and Konrad lingered over the fire together.
[d72] Carlos and Devon lingered over the fire together.
[d72] 🤒 Fatima is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. Fatima is already boiling water. It's handled.
[d73] — DAY 73 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
[d73] 💬 Konrad says: "The voice said 'north.' Just... north. I don't know what it means."
[d73] Dawn. You wake rested. (+18 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
[d73] No risky water to boil.
[d73] Drank clean water.
[d73] 📋 Konrad — 💧 Fetch water. Konrad nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
[d73] You don't know how to make a Arrow yet.
[d73] 💧 Konrad returns with 14L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
[d73] — MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
[d73] The relief moment passes — the crisis runs its own course now. What you did stands; what you didn't, doesn't.
[d73] You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
[d73] You don't know how to make a Arrow yet.
[d73] You catch fragments by the fire — Ivy telling Fatima about Zoe. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
[d73] Someone's retelling it again — Fatima, out past the ridge. Devon says "Fatima would've gone farther if we'd let them."
[d73] — DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
[d73] You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
[d73] You don't know how to make a Arrow yet.
[d73] 🍲 Konrad is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
[d73] — NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
[d73] Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
[d73] You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
